decision_basis: Five first-round required jobs were canceled. Windows funded library lacks a full result and cohort completion. Completed target results and named test success are retained only within their precise scopes. C4 is frozen unaccepted; later rerun status does not alter this first-round review.
method: Read exact committed C4 source via git show and immutable source expectations, not the worktree.
Read each original raw job log and metadata; verify SHA-256, full byte length, exact checkout/source/base and step conclusions.
Match target announcements to results FIFO to handle stdout/stderr interleaving; never assign a prior target result to the next announced target.
Match every new expected platform-specific test full name to exactly one actual ok line per relevant job.
Do not execute tests, trigger CI, poll GitHub, splice other jobs into partial results, or credit a command header as completed execution.

source_semantics_exercised.stdout_seventh_cli: Both funded interface logs show complete ok for the existing seventh test. Its unconditional body exercises checkpoint/verify/backup/restore, readonly File write-failure probe, exit code 1 for each mode, a writable File JSON success control, immutable source/sink assertions, byte-exact completed backup/restore targets and separate subsequent verification. Four modes remain one top-level test.
source_semantics_exercised.genuine_cli_payments: The first CLI test succeeded on both platforms; exact source contains two genuine payment-proof builds, backup/restore scan and receiver onward spend with balance/fee conservation. These are two builds inside one test, not two extra tests.
source_semantics_exercised.funded_library_growth: Both library logs contain actual ok for the growth test, including the canceled Windows library. Unconditional exact-source assertions exercise genuine payment-driven second physical segment, height 10001, original-pin and fully repinned physical segment swaps both returning Corrupt with source/fixture bytes and namespace unchanged, real backup/restore and continuation through 10002. This individual completed test does not complete the canceled Windows library suite.
source_semantics_exercised.repinned_bad_signature: Both library logs contain actual ok for active_profile_domain_rejections_preserve_bytes_reservations_and_legacy_contract; its invoked helper mutates a genuine binding signature, recomputes record checksum and pin, and asserts Authorization rejection on ordinary open and ActiveArchive without byte changes.
limits: Windows null-handle guard has no dedicated runtime fixture.
Swapped physical segment rejection exercises chain/order base-hash corruption, not authorization verification.
No stage-wide acceptance or security-audit claim follows from these cases.
